description: An award winning favorite, best picked when 20cm long for top flavor.
sowing_method: Sow in average, well-drained soil in full sun in spring after danger of frost. Sow 4-6 seeds about 8cm apart in hills 90cm apart. Cover with 3cm of fine soil; firm lightly and keep evenly moist. Seedlings emerge in 7-14 days.

data_sources.notes: life_cycle='annual' inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Cucumbers are typically grown as annuals in Belgium because they are sensitive to frost and are planted anew each year.
edible_parts=['fruit'] inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Cucumbers are typically eaten as a fruit in the common-sense gardener grouping.

plant_spacing_cm substituted from row_spacing_cm (GitHub issue #170: no source distinguishes in-row plant spacing from row spacing for this plant) - NOT an independently-sourced value, just a carried-over placeholder.

seeds_per_gram=34.17 derived from University of Maryland Extension's 'Table G-1: Vegetable Seed Sizes', category 'cucumbers' (15,000-16,000 seeds/lb, midpoint converted to seeds/gram); cross-referenced for consistency against several other independent university extension seed-size tables (see GitHub issue #61 / etl/backfill_seeds_per_gram.py for the full sourcing/licensing rationale, including why this is treated as factual data rather than a protectable compilation).
